book.name: 1 Corintios
book.title: Pablo nagkamchaku carta agaja corintonmaya aidau awetimu

content: Kumpamkagtamu
Witjai Pabloitjai, Jesucristo apostoljiyaitjai Apajuí wakegau asamtai, yatsug Sostenesjai pujusan,

atum iglesia Apajuinu aidautijum yaakat Corinto batsatutijum Cristo Jesús pegkeemtiki mina aentsug pegkejam atinme tusa, ashí tikich nugkanmaya aidau Jesucristo daajin adaiyina nujai etegtamjau asa ditá Apuji iina Apujiya nunú,
Apajuí iina Apajiya nunú, Apu Jesucristujai wait anenjamag, shiig agkan pujutan atumnash amastinme.
Pablo Apajuí see tabau
Tuke Apajuí see tusanké ajai atumin pachisan, atum Cristo Jesús nemajuidau asagmin, Apajuí wait anenjamjaju asamtai.
Wagki atumnak Apajuí Cristo Jesusai ashí pegkeg wakannumia aina nunak amasajui: Chichatan nuigtú dekatnashkam,
nunisag wi Cristo pachisan etsegkauwaitag dushakam atuminig imanisag juwatjamkajui.
Nunin asamtai Apajuí don sujamsamua duka ajutjamainawai, iina Apuji Jesucristo wantinkatnuji dakakjum batsatjum dui.
Apajuí nigki kuitamjamkattagme, ii Apuji Jesucristo minitta duwish bakumamainchau agtinme tujamu asa.
Apajuik ni anagkagtuamujinak imatiksag uminai, nigki etegtamjauwai niina Uchijí Jesucristo iina Apujiya nujai ijutkau pujustinme tusa.
Jesucristo nemajin tupandaiyinamu

Yatsug aidauh, iina Apuji Jesucristo daajin segajime, ashí atum aidautigmek tuké betek atuesajum takastajum, nuniamunum atsutí kanainamu, shiig anendaisajum pujustajum, nuniau asajum dutikatasa anentaimtamugmik nuní nuninuk anentaimtamu atinme.
Mina yatsug aidauh, junak tajime, atum pampandayá batsatjum nuna, Cloé patayí dekamtijuau asamtai.

Juna titag tajime, atum ainajum anuiya: “Wika Pablon nemagnaitjai”, tai; tikich: “Wika Apolon nemagnaitjai”, tawai. Nuniai: “Wika Cefasan nemagnaitjai” tai, tikich: “Wika Cristo nemagnaitjai”, tau awai.
¿Cristush akanjamukaih? ¿Pablok atumiin achinjauwait? ¿Nuniachkugmesh Pablo daajinig yamigbau ainajum?
Wika atumnak yamigchauwaitjim dui Apajuin see tajai, imá Crisponak, Gayojaig yamigbaijai,
makichkish mina daajui yamigbau ainaji tujutijum tau asan.
Estefanasa patayinash yamigbaijai, nuigtuk dekatsjai tikichnash yamijuashitag nunak.

Minak Cristuk yamijatjata tusag awetichui, yamajam chicham etsegkata tusa awetiuwai; aents niina yachajin chichamaina nuniknuk etsegkashbaijai, Cristo cruznum achigbauwa nuna wainkaya nunin diisainum tau asan.
Apajuí yachajiya duka aentsú yachajijaig betekchauwai
Cristo cruznum jakauwa nu pachisa etsegbauwa nunak wainak diinawai, megkaetanum batsata duka; tujash jutii uwemjau aidautinmag, ju chicham etsegbauwa juka Apajuí senchijiyai.
Chicham agagbaushkam:

content.text: “Wi yacha aidaunak yachachu emaktatjai, dutikakun dekataijinash emegkatjattajai”, tawai.

content: ¡Apajuí ju nugkanmaya unuimat aidaunak wainak emake! dutikamu asa yacha aidau, chicham umiktinnash jintikagtin nuigtú tikichjai chicham ataish imaakas chichau aina dushakam wainak juwakaje
Wagki Apajuí ni yachajin iwainakua nunak aentsuk ditá yachajiya nujaig dekamainchau wajasajui, tujash Apajuik wakeekauwai, chicham etsegbaun imanchau diinaigkesh dekaskeapi tuina nuna uwemtikatatus.
Judío aidauk wainchatai iwainamun wainkatatus wakegainawai, nuniai griego aidauk aentsú yachajin antuktatus wakegainawai.
Tujash jutiik Cristo numinum achinjauwa nu pachisa etsejuinaji, nunak judío aidauk dakitus diinai, judiochu aina duka wainkaya nunin diinawai.
Tujash Apajuí untsukbau aina nudauk, judío akush, griego akushkam, Cristuk Apajuí senchijiyai nuigtú Apajuí yachajiyai.
Apajuinu imanchau diyamua nuuwai aentsú yachajiya nuna nagkaesauwa nu, Apajuinu kakaakchau diyamua nuuwai aentsú senchijiya nuna nagkaesau senchigtina duka.
Yatsug aidauh, atumek, aents diismak yacha wajakin, apu chichame antugtai aina iman, eme anentsá diitai ainatsjum duka dekaamagme.
Nunin ainagminig Apajuik, aents yacha aidaun inatsakta tau asa, aents wainkauchia nuna etegkauwai. Dutiksag aents chichame antugtai aidaun inatsaktatus, aents imanchauch aina nuna etegkauwai.
Apajuik aents imanchauch diyaku jujú nugka juig dakitjamu aina nuna etegjauwai, aents eme anentai aina duka wainak juwaktinme tau asa.
Nunak Apajuik, niina eemtinish ditak eme anenmaminum tau asa dutikauwai.
Tujash Apajuiya duke atumnak Cristo Jesusai ijupajajui, dutijama Cristunak iina yachají, iina pegkeg etamin, iina pegkeemtijamin nuigtú iina agkanmitkagbau emauwai.
Nunin asamtai chicham agagbauwa nuwish: “Makichik aentskesh eme anenmamjatatus wakegauk, Apu Jesusai eme anenmamjati”, tibau awai.
